description: This is a C# unit test source file for testing lifecycle management logic in a software project. It contains multiple test methods to validate correct behavior of lifecycle observers during start and stop phases, including failure scenarios and multi-stage participation.

classes.name: LifecycleTests
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying lifecycle behavior with different observer scenarios.

classes.name: TestLifecycleSubject
classes.description: A test-specific subclass of LifecycleSubject used within the tests.

classes.name: Observer
classes.description: Implements ILifecycleObserver to simulate lifecycle observers, capable of failing on start/stop for testing.

classes.name: MultiStageObserver
classes.description: Participates in multiple lifecycle stages, tracking start and stop calls.

methods.name: FullLifecycleTest
methods.description: Tests complete lifecycle consistency with multiple observers across all stages.

methods.name: FailOnStartOnEachStageLifecycleTest
methods.description: Tests lifecycle behavior when observers are configured to fail on start at each stage.

methods.name: FailOnStopOnEachStageLifecycleTest
methods.description: Tests lifecycle behavior when observers are configured to fail on stop at each stage.

methods.name: MultiStageObserverLifecycleTest
methods.description: Verifies multi-stage observer participation and correctness during lifecycle start and stop.

methods.name: RunLifecycle
methods.description: Helper method to set up observers and run lifecycle start/stop sequences, capturing results.
